action_center.method: Conservative deterministic recommendations based on current 28-day Google Search Console performance compared with the previous 28 days. Small CTR samples are treated as watch items rather than urgent issues. Query-level declines take precedence over duplicate page-level alerts. Recommendations are diagnostic prompts and do not automatically modify the website.

limitations: GSC average position is impression-weighted performance data, not a deterministic live SERP rank. GSC does not provide competitor or Google Maps grid rankings.
